ProductSection.Info: The settings of this MEHO appliance

Property.Label: Host name
Property.Description: The full DNS name of the appliance, for example meho.example.com. It must resolve in your DNS.

Property.Label: Time servers
Property.Description: One or more NTP servers, comma-separated.

Property.Label: Network: static or DHCP
Property.Description: static: the three fields below set the address. dhcp: the appliance takes an address from DHCP and the fields below stay empty.

Property.Label: IP address with prefix
Property.Description: For a static address only, for example 10.0.0.10/24.

Property.Label: DNS servers
Property.Description: For a static address only. One or more, comma-separated.

Property.Label: Admin network
Property.Description: The IPv4 address range that may use SSH, for example 10.0.50.0/24. From every other address only the web console (ports 80 and 443) answers.

Property.Label: Appliance admin password
Property.Description: The password of the Linux account admin, for the VM console and sudo. At least 14 characters. You must change it at the first login.

Property.Label: Admin SSH public key
Property.Description: The public key that may log in as admin over SSH. SSH takes only keys, no passwords.

Property.Label: Join address
Property.Description: The address of a MEHO node to join. Leave empty for a single appliance.

Property.Label: Join token
Property.Description: The token of the node to join. Leave empty for a single appliance.

Property.Label: Virtual IP
Property.Description: One shared address that always points to a working node. Leave empty for a single appliance.
